# Health & Hygiene Report 0.1.9

## Updates

- Prefills Health & Hygiene assessment scores from the latest earlier audit for the same vessel.
- Shows a confirmation message when scores were copied, while keeping all scores editable for the current audit.
- Prevents checklist section headings from being stranded at the bottom of a Word page.
- Enlarges single evidence photos in Word exports while preserving their aspect ratio.

Existing project data is preserved. Users can review and adjust every prefilled score before saving the current audit.
